title: Aromatic Uruguayan Rhubarb Pie
description: A pungent and romantic Uruguayan dessert featuring rhubarb and bonito shave, made in a kazan cauldron, this pie is a unique blend of flavors and textures, and is whole30 friendly.
instructions: Preheat the kazan cauldron over medium heat to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mix the rhubarb, bonito shave, and coconut sugar in a large bowl.
Add the almond flour, coconut oil, eggs, salt, and vanilla extract to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough and place it in the preheated kazan cauldron.
Fill the dough with the rhubarb mixture and fold the dough over the filling.
Bake the pie for 45 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove the pie from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the pie warm and enjoy.
